overview: A full-service property broker platform for sales, rental, and consultation services across Indonesia. The website serves as a digital storefront to build trust, generate leads, and showcase property listings.

projectState.orderSource: Business onboarding form with design reference

actors.name: Pemilik Properti
actors.role: Property owners looking to sell or rent their properties

actors.name: Investor Properti
actors.role: Property investors looking for investment opportunities

actors.name: Penyewa
actors.role: Individuals and families seeking rental properties

actors.name: Pelaku Usaha
actors.role: Business owners seeking commercial properties (ruko, gudang, kantor)

actors.name: Admin
actors.role: Internal team managing property listings, inventory catalog, and site content

modules.name: Hero Section
modules.description: Animated hero with wordmark, stacked property cards, and smooth scroll-triggered animations

features.text: Large animated wordmark with Aresphi branding
Stacked property cards with parallax effect
Meta card showing featured property info
Admin can select which property photos appear

modules.name: Partner Logos
modules.description: Marquee-style scrolling bank partner logos section

features.text: Bank partner logos: BNI, BJB, BTN, BRI, BCA, BPR, BPR HIK, BWS (Bank Woori Saudara), Bank Sampoerna
Greyscale logo treatment for visual consistency

modules.name: USP Section
modules.description: Bento grid layout highlighting key differentiators: transparency, personal service, responsiveness, effective marketing, integrity

features.text: Large testimonial card with client photo
Flashlight effect cards for USP items
Dark stats card showing transparency metric

modules.name: Stats Section
modules.description: Dark background section displaying company achievements

modules.name: Process Section
modules.description: Staggered cards showing the 3-step client journey: Konsultasi Awal, Kurasi Properti, Pendampingan Transaksi

features.text: Step 1: Konsultasi Awal - understanding client needs
Step 2: Kurasi Properti - curated property selection

modules.name: Property Showcase
modules.description: Horizontal scrolling gallery of featured properties with pricing and location

features.text: Property cards with grayscale-to-color hover effect
Price badges (Rp 2.5 M, Rp 35 jt/bln, etc.)
Admin can select which property photos appear

modules.name: Quote Section
modules.description: Full-width hero image with centered quote about home buying philosophy

features.text: Quote about home as life-changing experience

modules.name: Footer
modules.description: Contact information, social links, and large watermark

features.text: Address: Jl. Sudirman No. 123, Jakarta Selatan

modules.name: Navigation
modules.description: Floating navigation bar with glassmorphism effect

features.text: Floating pill-shaped navbar with blur effect

modules.name: Property Management
modules.description: Admin interface to manage property inventory catalog with CRUD operations

features.text: CRUD operations for property inventory catalog
Image upload to Vercel Blob for property photos
Admin selects which photos appear in each section
Dashboard with tabs for Properties, Stats, Hero photos

modules.name: Lead Capture
modules.description: Contact form with mailto and WhatsApp deep link integration

features.text: Contact form with name, email, phone, message
WhatsApp deep link for direct contact

modules.name: Property Detail Page
modules.description: Individual property listing page with full details, photo gallery, and contact CTA

features.text: Property information: price, location, specs, description

modules.name: Catalog Page
modules.description: Property catalog/listing page with filters for type, price, location

constraints.text: Design must match provided aresphi-preview.html exactly
Admin auth via static env credentials (no OAuth)
